playSound.description: Plays a sound from the 'sounds/' folder.

parameters.volume: Volume level from 0 to 1. Defaults to 1 (full volume).
parameters.tag: Tag identifier for later control. Defaults to null.

examples: Plays the confirm sound at full volume.

parameters.volume: Volume level from 0 to 1. Defaults to 1.
parameters.loop: Whether music loops. Defaults to true.

soundFadeIn.description: Fades in a sound over time.

soundFadeOut.description: Fades out a sound over time.

parameters.tag: Sound tag or file name to stop.

setSoundVolume.description: Sets the volume of a sound (0.0 to 1.0).
